## Context / Problem
Four `graph` functions carry moderate cyclomatic complexity in the checked-in ratchet (`.github/complexity-baseline.json`): `_blockers.py::_find_direct_blockers` (18), `_graph.py::_get_all_blocked_by` (20), `_graph.py::check_cycle_at_level` (16), `_unblock.py::detect_newly_unblocked` (22). These are LOW-RISK (pure logic, `graph.*` is in the mypy strictness ratchet, extensive existing tests), with zero in-progress contention. The high-risk orchestrators (`next_batch.compute` CCN 42, `import_ndjson.import_tickets` CCN 45) are deliberately EXCLUDED. Flagged by audit ae1b.

## Root cause (architectural)
`graph/_loader.py` is a 15-line shim that stops at raw `reduce_ticket`/`reduce_all_tickets`. Because the package lacks a higher-level loader/traversal layer, the same infrastructure is hand-rolled in every query and is the direct source of both the high CCN and the file growth:
- The "reduce_all → drop `error`/`fsck_needed` → index by id" loop is duplicated verbatim in `_find_direct_blockers` (_blockers.py:34-40), `_compute_dep_graph` (_graph.py:65-72), and (as a scandir/tombstone variant) `detect_newly_unblocked` (_unblock.py:51-79).
- `_get_all_blocked_by` (_graph.py:127) and `check_cycle_at_level` (_graph.py:223) each re-implement an FS-walking BFS with per-node `reduce_ticket` + `os.listdir` + exception swallowing.

## Approach (fix the cause, not just the symptom)
Promote `_loader.py`/`_relations.py` into the package's real loader+traversal layer, then re-express the four functions as thin consumers. This removes the duplicated infrastructure so the NEXT graph query reuses it instead of hand-rolling a fifth traversal (recurrence prevention).

1. Add `load_indexed_states(tracker_dir, *, exclude_archived=False) -> dict[str, dict]` to `graph/_loader.py` — the one canonical "reduce_all + drop error/fsck + index by id" (replacing the 3 duplicated loops). Add a `scandir`/tombstone-aware variant (or a `tombstone_status=True` flag) covering `detect_newly_unblocked`'s needs.
2. Add a generic `bfs(starts, neighbors_fn) -> set[str]` traversal skeleton to `graph/_relations.py` (which already hosts `build_blocked_by`, :15).
3. Rewrite consumers:
   - `_find_direct_blockers` → `load_indexed_states` + two named source-helpers `_own_depends_on_blockers` / `_blocks_targeting` (the two sources already named in its docstring). Target CCN ≤ 6.
   - `_get_all_blocked_by` → build the adjacency once from indexed states, then `bfs`. Target CCN ≤ 6.
   - `check_cycle_at_level` → level-filtered adjacency + `bfs`. Target CCN ≤ 6.
   - `detect_newly_unblocked` → `load_indexed_states` (its inline scandir/tombstone loop removed) + reuse `build_blocked_by`; keep only the readiness logic. Target CCN ≤ 10.

Rationale (G6): the duplication is the measured cause of the CCN and of `_graph.py`'s size; centralizing it in the loader/traversal layer is the minimal structural change that both lowers complexity now and prevents its recurrence, and it stays behavior-identical (same nodes, same filtering, same traversal order for reachability sets). Update `.github/complexity-baseline.json` ceilings downward only.

## Scope
- `src/rebar/graph/_loader.py` — add `load_indexed_states` (+ tombstone variant).
- `src/rebar/graph/_relations.py` — add `bfs` traversal helper.
- `src/rebar/graph/_blockers.py` — rewrite `_find_direct_blockers` on the shared helpers.
- `src/rebar/graph/_graph.py` — rewrite `_get_all_blocked_by`, `check_cycle_at_level`, and the duplicated loader in `_compute_dep_graph` to use `load_indexed_states`.
- `src/rebar/graph/_unblock.py` — rewrite `detect_newly_unblocked` on the shared loader.
- `.github/complexity-baseline.json` — lower the four ceilings (shrink-only).

## Verification (behavior-preserving refactor)
- The existing graph unit/interface tests are the behavioral oracle and pass unchanged (blocker discovery, cycle detection, and newly-unblocked batch all covered under `tests/unit` + `tests/interfaces`).
- Complexity gate green with the four ceilings lowered; mypy (graph is ratchet-gated) + lint green.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `.github/complexity-baseline.json` records CCN for all four functions at or below: `_find_direct_blockers` ≤ 6, `_get_all_blocked_by` ≤ 6, `check_cycle_at_level` ≤ 6, `detect_newly_unblocked` ≤ 10; the shrink-only ratchet test passes.
- [ ] The duplicated "reduce_all → filter → index" loop appears exactly once (in `load_indexed_states`); `grep -n "fsck_needed" src/rebar/graph/*.py` shows it only in `_loader.py`.
- [ ] Graph outputs are unchanged: the full graph unit + interface suites pass with no test edits.
- [ ] `mypy src/rebar/graph`, complexity, and lint gates green.
